trimmed:  nothing removed. Machine paths REDACTED after capture (this repository is public), mechanically, with
          sed -e 's#<session scratch dir>/#/work/#g' -e 's#/home/<user>/.cargo/#~/.cargo/#g' -e 's#/home/<user>/.rustup/#~/.rustup/#g'
          so the scratch copy reads as /work/byteorder-cap and the operator's cargo and rustup homes as ~/.cargo and ~/.rustup.
          Every other byte is as captured; the parsers read only FAIL/FLAKY/---- lines, which carry no path.
